exposure: Cesarean section in the first stage of labor
Cesarean section in the second stage of labor
cohort: 383 term parturient women who underwent primary cesarean section during active labor at a tertiary health care university facility over a 24-month period
finding: Cesarean sections performed in the second stage of labor were associated with a significantly higher rate of unintentional uterine incision extensions, particularly when performed for non-progressive labor.
